scope: Proposition 8.1 of the manuscript “Uniform effective log Iitaka fibrations for fourfolds” (preprints/Uniform-effective-log-Iitaka-fibrations-for-fourfolds-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8036215575dbf619), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is no sequence of finite cyclic covers πν : Yν −→ Xν of normal projective fourfolds, generically torsors for cyclic groups Gν of orders rν → ∞, with the following properties. The group Bir(Xν) is countable, and there are ample rational Cartier divisors Lν on Xν and constants c, C > 0, independent of ν, such that at very general points ε(Lν) ≥ c, ε(π∗ ν Lν) ≥ cr1/4 ν . Moreover, for each fixed integer t ≥ 2, put Zν,t = Yt ν/Gν,diag, θν,t : Zν,t −→ Xt ν, Pν,t = θ∗ ν,tL⊞t ν . Here L⊞t = ∑t i=1 pr∗ i L. The further required bound is ε(Pν,t) ≤ Ct2 at a very general point, for all sufficiently large ν, with this threshold allowed to depend on t.
